JOB TITLE: Manufacturing Engineer (Contract-to-Hire)
LOCATION: Grand Rapids, MI 49512
PAY RATE: $38.00 - $45.00/hr W2
DURATION: 6 months+

Our client, a leading Tier 1 automotive supplier, is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join their team!

Job Duties:
* Develop and improve stamping and welding processes
* Lead PFMEA and control plan updates per IATF 16949
* Implement lean manufacturing and 5S initiatives on the shop floor
* Create work instructions and documentation

Skills Required:
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering
* 3+ years in automotive manufacturing
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD
* Experience with APQP and PPAP

Skills Preferred:
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* PLC experience (Allen-Bradley preferred)

Why work with us?
We offer weekly pay, medical, dental and 401k options to our contractors!

#LI-JB1 #IND123
